steps: Delete the temporary acceptance-test grain after the visible launch probe completes.

fixtures.name: disposable-provider-connection
fixtures.purpose: Exercise one reversible sidecar-routed connection test without storing a production provider credential.
fixtures.setup: Provision it only for the acceptance run; do not include credentials in this contract.

launchProbe.expectedResult: AiLagoon launches through its normal UI and preserves its PowerBox and grainauth boundaries.

steps.action: Install the candidate through the governed Bazaar path and launch a new AiLagoon grain through its normal app action.
steps.expectedResult: The normal UI and Connections view render without an authz denial, blank page, reset loop or process failure. The platform authz identity and tenant license binding are validated; a platform-supplied binding takes precedence over the package fallback, and writable configuration cannot replace it.

steps.action: Configure a provider connection through the normal PowerBox HTTP-out flow; do not use a direct network bypass.
steps.expectedResult: The connection is saved through the grain UI and requests use the configured capability.

steps.action: From a permitted disposable peer, obtain an AiLagoon bundle through the normal PowerBox flow, make one bounded request, then revoke or drop that bundle and restart the grain.
steps.expectedResult: The bundle works only while its consumer-bound grant is active. A failed fulfillment, revoked or dropped bundle, and an unresolved pending grant after restart are unusable rather than silently retaining capability access.

steps.action: Configure an OpenRouter model that advertises input_references support, enable Image creation / editing, and run its connection test through granted HTTP-out.
steps.expectedResult: Availability is checked without a paid image generation. A missing grant, unsupported provider/model or failed catalog response leaves the connection unavailable.

steps.action: From Bureau Paint, claim the native AIImage capability, add the visible layer composite and an image pasted with Ctrl+V, and submit a synthetic prompt through the real configured provider. Review the returned image, insert it as a layer, Undo, insert again, save and reload.
steps.expectedResult: The selected model receives both bounded reference images. The response is one validated inline image. Paint does not edit the document before explicit insertion; the result is an editable layer and survives save/reload. The saved connection restores after reopening.

steps.action: Cancel an active image request, disconnect its model, and attempt another request using the saved capability. Exercise model reference limits, malformed images and configured cost limits with disposable fixtures.
steps.expectedResult: Canceled or revoked work cannot insert or return a late result. Request limits and permission checks refuse before provider work. Reported charges survive discarded results; absent costs are shown as unreported and prevent further requests under a configured limit in the active window. Prompts and images do not appear in audit metadata.

steps.action: Attempt a mutating action with the grain authz socket or valid license authority unavailable.
steps.expectedResult: The grain visibly refuses the action rather than bypassing grainauth.

safeProbe.action: In a fresh AiLagoon grain, use the visible Connections flow to grant HTTP-out for exactly https://ailagoon.sidecar.host, then run the connection test against a disposable provider fixture.
safeProbe.expectedResult: The Powerbox grant and connection test complete without a 403, TLS failure, or direct-provider bypass; the configured request is routed through the declared sidecar.
